text:
Alex R: quick thread — we should settle on a single canonical usage event (raw vs billing-ready) and how to annotate corrections/backfills
Priya M: +1. Our downstream billing ledger expects idempotent, monotonic charge events. late-arrivals currently create duplicate credits
Jonah L: proposal: keep two event types: raw_usage (immutable) and billing_adjustment (mutable/audit). raw_usage is append-only and contains a provenance pointer to the original request
Tessa N: how do we dedupe raw_usage across retries? client_request_id not reliable frequently
Alex R: use ingress_fingerprint = HMAC(tenant_key, client_request_id || model || req_ts_floor) — generated at edge. store fingerprint in raw_usage
Priya M: edge HMAC ok but need key rotation plan and documented algorithm. also what about multi-tenant proxies? include tenant in input to HMAC to avoid cross-tenant collisions
Jonah L: agreed. also add ingest_window field (e.g., 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z/PT1H) so downstream can align billing granules without inferring
Tessa N: for attribution: don't bake token attribution into raw_usage. instead emit optional attribution_summary for heavy callers or sampled requests
Alex R: sampling must be deterministic for audits: suggested deterministic_sampler = sha256(fingerprint) % 10000 < sample_rate*10000
Priya M: for large token runs, token attribution can be too big. design: attribution_summary is capped to N entries; if bigger, write full breakdown to artifact store and include artifact_ref
Jonah L: artifact_ref should be a short id; artifact service returns signed URL for 1h. also track artifact_size and artifact_hash in the event
Tessa N: need a size threshold. let's set threshold at 6KB for the proto. events exceeding that auto-offload
Alex R: late-arrivals: raw_usage gets a status field: accepted | late_arrival | reconciled. billing_adjustment references raw_usage.fingerprint and applies delta
Priya M: reconcile window: charges can be adjusted up to 90 days. we must record correction_reason and operator_id in adjustments for audit
Jonah L: migration: schema_v1 is current. plan: schema_v2 introduces fingerprint + ingest_window + attribution_summary. rollout steps: 1) publish schema_v2 as opt-in; 2) start emitting v2 for internal tenants; 3) expose a compatibility proxy to translate v2->v1 for external partners for 8 weeks; 4) compare ledgers
Tessa N: testing: we need a transform test harness that runs N synthetic events through shim and asserts parity in aggregated billing metrics
Alex R: telemetry: add observable_tags to events for routing in ingestion and for canary dashboards (e.g., canary=true)
Priya M: owner alignment: Jonah -> artifacts & shim, Tessa -> test harness & canary dashboard, Alex -> rollout comms & documentation
MeteringBot: checklist: publish-schema, deploy-ingest-shim, create-artifact-bucket, add-canary-dashboards, document-key-rotation
Alex R: actionables done. I'll post a small example payload in RFC: ```json
{"schema":"v2","tenant":"acme","fingerprint":"hmac:...","client_request_id":"r-1","token_total":"2048","attribution_summary":[{"component":"embed","tokens":1800}],"ingest_window":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z/PT1H","status":"accepted","artifact_ref":null,"meta":{"sampler_hash":"0xabc","flags":["attr_summary"]}}
```
Priya M: love it. meeting to sync owners next Wed 10am
Jonah L: noted
Tessa N: :rocket:
Alex R: closing this thread; will add RFC diff and timeline to the repo later
